title: helenium foliosum
intro: Helenium foliosum, commonly known as false sneezeweed, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with benefits including lowering fever, treating snake bites, and providing relief from inflammation and infections. The therapeutic actions of Helenium foliosum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and anti-spasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Helenium foliosum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
